verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a first-party Vast Serverless product: it runs workloads without managing GPUs, bills for execution rather than rental time, and automatically recruits GPUs to scale a workload. Endpoints can be deployed and driven via the CLI, the agent skill and a Python SDK. Scale-to-zero behaviour is only implied by the pay-per-execution model and is never explicitly documented, and the autoscaling mechanics are described only at headline level. missing for 10: explicit scale-to-zero documentation, details of autoscaling policies and cold starts, hands-on or independent corroboration of serverless deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Vast Serverless is an AI infrastructure platform that lets you run compute-intensive workloads without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time.
Benchmark-driven scaling: Automatic identification and recruitment of the best price-performance GPU to scale your unique workload.
Interacting with Vast Serverless is made easy through a powerful python SDK.
